title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX (purported 2nd gen) > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery early‑70 show, highlighted by a smoking “Mason’s Children” and a fierce “China Cat Sunflower.”
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great, crystal‑clear sound – a true testament to SirMick’s mastering. The band was “really on,” delivering tight, concise performances with standout moments on Mason’s Children and China Cat Sunflower, making it a solid addition for early‑70 Dead fans.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers are enthusiastic (average 4.7★), noting superb soundboard quality and strong performances; the show is deemed essential for early‑70 fans despite one modest comment about song brevity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great clarity and balance reported by reviewers; no dropouts or muffling mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Songs are concise and energetic, with a slightly shorter‑than‑usual duration that some find refreshing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fierce playing highlighted, especially on China Cat Sunflower.
